beats.title: Stafl Busks for Intel and Gold on the Street
beats.summary: As the group heads toward the Acrobatics Extravaganza at the Glimmering Globe near noon, Stafl busks on the street to gather intel on the Shepherd and his Flock, earning 33 gold. Karsemine is disappointed to learn the event is a show, not a competition, until Ephanna convinces her to sneak in and participate. The other two find the back door open and meet Winna again, exasperated by their rule-bending.

beats.title: Forged Performer List Discovered by Wet Ink
beats.summary: While Karsemine performs acrobatic feats to distract Winna, Ephanna forges Karsemine’s name onto the performer list. Winna initially feels relief that the name is listed, but notices the still-wet ink and kicks them out. A guard then confronts Stafl about busking without a permit; the group presents their badges, and the guard recognizes them as Questionable Company, saviors of the city, mentioning that everyone remains on edge about the missing guards.

Caelynn begins searching for the conservatory.

beats.title: Combat Trials: Tavern Brawl Against Hagan
beats.summary: The team of Bonogo, Baergrom, and Ogonob faces a Human Barbarian Druid named Hagan in a magically transformed tavern arena. Hagan shoulder-charges Bonogo, who responds with darts and sneak attacks. Ogonob lands punches, triggering Hagan’s transformation into a giant bear. Baergrom lands three of four punches, but the bear swipes Bonogo and uses the bar for cover.

beats.title: Bottles, Clubs, and Darts End the Brawl
beats.summary: Bonogo throws darts and later uses a broken bottle to slash the bear. Baergrom creates a makeshift shield and club from a barstool, then breaks a bottle into a dagger to attack. Ogonob lands a devastating final punch, bouncing Hagan’s head off the floorboards and ending the fight. The recap closes with a list of delicious food items enjoyed.
